lookup_spirv_opcode: lookup the SPIR-V opcode integer value for a given operation name from the spv['Op'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_capability: lookup the SPIR-V capability integer value for a given feature name from the spv['Capability'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_decoration: lookup the SPIR-V decoration integer value for a given metadata attribute from the spv['Decoration'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_storage_class: lookup the SPIR-V storage class integer value for a given memory scope from the spv['StorageClass'] dictionary
lookup_spirv_source_language: lookup the SPIR-V source language integer value for a given shader language from the spv['SourceLanguage'] dictionary
